description: “It was the best of times; it was the worst of times. It was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief and the epoch of incredulity, it was a season of light, it was the season of darkness….We were all going directly to Heaven, and we were all going the other way….”I’m paraphrasing the words Charles Dickens wrote in 1859 to recall his point that things may change but they stay the same. In a 21st century world where we can hold an image in our hands of an event
